title: Update PWA splash screen to full-screen background image without logo

requirements.text: Update the PWA splash screen to display the user-provided background image URL as a full-screen static background, removing any logo overlay entirely

quotes: PWA splash screen – Using your provided background image as a full-screen static splash with no logo overlay

acceptanceCriteria: The splash screen displays only the background image with no logo visible
The background image fills the entire screen
The splash screen uses the static background image URL provided by the user in earlier conversation

constraints: Use the exact background image URL provided by the user in previous conversation context
Do not modify any backend files for this frontend-only change
Keep the scope limited to splash screen only - do not implement chat editing features in this build
nonGoals: Chat message editing and deletion functionality
Changes to the main app logo or branding
Modifications to other PWA configuration beyond the splash screen
